intro: A Felstalker Hoof is a physical token taken from demonic beasts infesting the Burning Blade Coven in Durotar's Valley of Trials. Young shaman must retrieve these hooves as a trial of readiness before learning to commune with the elemental spirits of the earth.

p: Within the sun-baked Valley of Trials, the trainer Canaga Earthcaller tasks budding shaman with facing the demonic taint threatening Durotar. The Burning Blade Coven to the north harbors vile familiars and demonic felstalkers. Taking the hooves of these fiends is not merely an act of culling pests, but a rigorous test of endurance, resolve, and spirit. Only by subduing these chaotic beasts can an aspiring shaman prove worthy of receiving the secrets of the earth and preparing the ceremonial sapta needed to commune directly with elemental spirits.
